_readme: Public addresses only (no keys, no seeds, no emails). The secret side lives in funding/.secrets/wallets.json, which no AI session reads. Fill each address after you create the wallet; drafts and pages point here for custody status.

wallets.label: pink-paw-receiving
wallets.notes: same value as campaign.json shelter.wallet and PROOF_SHELTER; being replaced by pink-paw-own (0x3c83…4771) via shelter rotate (Arc testnet 5042002 rehearsal and Arc 5042 USDC + EURC first, then the other six chains before 2026-12-05; read on-chain 2026-10-14: all 8 mainnet splits on 7 chains still pay this address); after each rotation, sweep the shelter funds left here to pink-paw-own; afterwards this address is only the Token Tails grant receiver (arc-grant-receiver)

wallets.label: pink-paw-own
wallets.role: Pink Paw's own self-custody wallet: the shelter payee after shelter rotate replaces pink-paw-receiving
wallets.notes: keystore pinkpaw-own; created by Token Tails for Pink Paw, NOT a Circle Wallet. custody becomes shelter-held only after the handover in applications/tameion/HANDOVER-PINKPAW.md: phrase on paper to Pink Paw staff, staff import it on their own phone, staff send 0.01 back as proof of control, founder deletes ~/.tokentails-wallets/pinkpaw-own and ~/.foundry/keystores/pinkpaw-own. Not in wallet.config.ts until the rotation is on-chain (walletConfig reads only pink-paw-receiving)

wallets.label: motored-sponsor
wallets.role: keystore motored: owner of the Motored.lt CappedSpender vault in the Match Desk (funds it, the only address that can withdraw the float)
wallets.notes: created by Token Tails for Motored.lt, the founder's company (related-party sponsor); disclose in every submission that Token Tails created and holds this key for Motored.lt; fund it only from Motored.lt's own money

wallets.label: shelter-split-treasury
wallets.role: SHELTERSPLIT_TREASURY: receives the remainder and rounding dust

wallets.label: deployer
wallets.role: keystore tokentails: deploys ShelterSplit and DonateRouter (FUND_KEYSTORE) and is the one wallet the person funds; distribute-mainnet.sh tops up the hot wallet and the agent from it; never the hot wallet

wallets.label: donate-hot-wallet
wallets.role: keystore donatehot = SHELTER_DONATE_PRIVATE_KEY on the backend: pays sponsored treats from a small float (funding-plan.json), topped up from the deployer by distribute-mainnet.sh

wallets.label: agent-wallet
wallets.role: keystore agent: the Tameion / x402 demo agent, topped up from the deployer by distribute-mainnet.sh

wallets.label: arc-grant-receiver
wallets.role: receives the Arc Microgrant (USDC on Arc)
wallets.notes: same address as pink-paw-receiving until the rotation; after the rotation and sweep it is only the Token Tails grant receiver

wallets.label: colosseum-team-leader
wallets.role: Colosseum prize payee, in the Team Leader's own name

wallets.label: testnet-shelter-split-treasury
wallets.role: treasury() of every testnet ShelterSplit (read on-chain 2026-10-04)

wallets.label: testnet-donate-hot-wallet
wallets.role: keystore donatehot: SHELTER_DONATE_PRIVATE_KEY of the local testnet backend (treats, relay gas)

wallets.label: testnet-deployer
wallets.role: keystore tokentails: deploys the testnet ShelterSplits and DonateRouters
